rules: Four factual screens precede the card bank. Scenarios use hypothetical CHF amounts with no intermediate cash flows.
Show C1, then C2 if needed. If C2 is still unclear, report the factual profile with risk tolerance undetermined.
Interleave trade-offs, loss comparisons and common reaction cards. Record the statement and swipe direction. Right always means yes. Counterbalance which financial outcome the statement favors.
Only A01–A20 inform φ. Contradictory choices trigger clarification or an uncertain estimate. A misunderstood choice provides no evidence of a preference.

After the common core, select an unseen card only when its trigger applies and it resolves a relevant uncertainty. Allow up to two unsuccessful probes per issue. B09 requires agreement across two separate loss comparisons.
End with one S card. Use the first applicable trigger from S01 to S05, otherwise S06. Allow corrections and skips throughout, then recompute dependent conclusions.
